mapper.sql: v.id, v.skill_id, v.version_no, v.files_json, v.checksum, v.entry_path, v.uploaded_by, v.created_at
FROM wb_workflow_node_skill ns JOIN wb_workflow_node n ON n.id = ns.node_id JOIN wb_workflow w ON w.id = n.workflow_id WHERE w.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.description, s.current_version_id, s.created_by, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at, v.version_no AS current_version_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) AND ns.skill_id = s.id) AS usage_count FROM wb_skill s LEFT JOIN wb_skill_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT id, project_id, name, description, current_version_id, created_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM wb_skill WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.name, s.description, s.current_version_id, s.created_by, s.deleted, s.created_at, s.updated_at, v.version_no AS current_version_no FROM wb_skill s LEFT JOIN wb_skill_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wb_skill (project_id, name, description, current_version_id, created_by, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{currentVersionId}, #{createdBy}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO wb_skill_version (skill_id, version_no, files_json, checksum, entry_path, uploaded_by, created_at) VALUES (#{skillId}, #{versionNo}, #{filesJson}, #{checksum}, #{entryPath}, #{uploadedBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wb_skill_version v WHERE v.skill_id = #{skillId} ORDER BY v.version_no ASC

SELECT 'workflow' AS kind, w.id AS workflow_id, w.name AS workflow_name, NULL AS requirement_id, NULL AS requirement_title, n.name AS node_name
AND ns.skill_id = #{skillId} UNION ALL SELECT 'requirement', NULL, NULL, r.id, r.title, rn.name FROM wb_requirement_node rn JOIN wb_requirement r ON r.id = rn.requirement_id WHERE r.status <> 'completed' AND JSON_CONTAINS(rn.skills_snapshot, JSON_OBJECT('skillId', #{skillId})) ORDER BY kind DESC, workflow_id, requirement_id, node_name
